scientific_limitations: General complete intersections over the complex numbers only.
The parametrized linear spaces have positive dimension k >= 1.
The theorem compares genus with Pluecker degree but does not determine the degree in general.
Special complete intersections with singular or excess-dimensional Fano schemes are outside scope.
An unindexed classical source could contain the same inequality explicitly.
title: Sharp genus-degree floor for one-dimensional Fano schemes of complete intersections
